 Order
The applicant has filed this first application u/S.438 Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail.

T h e applicant is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.169/2023 registered at Police Station Dehat, District Bhind (M.P.) fo r the offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(n),
506 of IPC.
T he allegation leveled against the present applicant/accused is that he committed raped upon the prosecutrix on false promise of marriage.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant-accused argued that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.
Prosecutrix is a major married woman having children.
The entire presentation story is highly suspicious because allegedly the present applicant-accused sexually assaulted the prosecutrix for more than 4-5 years.
However, the prosecutrix never complaint to her family members or lodged any report in police station.
The prosecutrix lodged the report only after when the applicant got engaged with another woman.

At the most, this is a case of consensual relationship and ingredients of Section 376(2)
(n) of IPC are not attracted.
The applicant is a Government Servant and in case, h e will arrest, then his entire career would be spoiled.
He has not criminal history.

It is submitted by the counsel for the applicant that the applicant is ready and willing to co-operate in the investigation and shall abide by all the terms and conditions as may be imposed by this Court; therefore, she prays for grant of anticipatory bail.
O n the other hand, learned State counsel as well as prosecutrix herself have vehemently opposed the application.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and material available on record, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that in the event of arrest, the applicant be released on bail, on executing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer/Investigating Authority.
The applicant shall further abide by other conditions enumerated under Section 438 (2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Certified copy as per rules.

(SUNITA YADAV) JUDGE Pj'S/-
